final: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), kept AS (SELECT avg_ratio, project_count FROM source_stats WHERE project_count > (SELECT AVG(project_count) FROM source_stats)) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_sources_ratio, SUM(project_count) AS total_distinct_projects, AVG(project_count - (SELECT AVG(project_count) FROM source_stats)) AS avg_excess_project_count FROM kept
